item.title: [7.9] France’s 10-year bond yield heads for biggest quarterly surge since 1987
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

France's bond yields have been rising sharply, with September seeing the largest increase in decades. Investors are concerned about inflation as energy costs continue to rise, impacting fiscal stability. The government plans to issue €340 billion in bonds next year, which could strain its fiscal position further.

WHY IT MATTERS

A historic 36-year quarterly bond yield surge in Europe's second-largest economy signals severe fiscal stress and broader contagion risks for the eurozone.

item.description:

item.description:

Recent advances in large language models have made automatic game generation increasingly feasible, yet reliably improving generated games beyond a playable version remains challenging. Naive iterative refinement can easily overfit a small set of test cases, producing fragile games with unresolved bugs, missing behaviors, and poor generalization to broader player interactions. We introduce...
